title: ReseedInternalBalances lacks farmers/balances length-equality check
description: setInternalBalances iterates i over farmers.length and reads balances[i] without requiring farmers.length == balances.length. A mismatch causes an out-of-bounds revert (or, if longer, the trailing entries are ignored but caught by the sum guard), making the internal-balance reseed fail.
impact: Migration of internal balances reverts on malformed input (DoS of that reseed step). Bounded; the totalInternalBalance guard also catches mismatches. Medium.

ite.intent: Credit each farmer its internal balance
ite.technique: Parallel-array indexing without a length-equality precondition
ite.evasion: No attacker; depends on upgrade caller input

ice_chain.impact: Reseed step reverts on bad input
ice_chain.exploit_path: init with unequal arrays -> balances[i] OOB -> revert
